verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch supports some bulk actions—bulk edit of request parameters, simultaneous import of multiple collections/environments, and CLI-driven execution of entire test collections—plus an MCP server that lets an AI agent read/change collections, requests, environments, and teams programmatically. However, there's no evidence of a general bulk API/agent action for arbitrary multi-item edits (e.g., bulk rename, bulk delete, bulk header updates) beyond the parameter bulk-edit feature. Missing for 10: documented bulk operations beyond parameters (e.g., bulk request/collection edits, bulk delete), and independent confirmation that the MCP server supports true bulk agent actions rather than one-at-a-time reads/writes.
